versions.changelog:
Version 2.0.0

- Major overhaul: Shifted from lobster/shrimp card generation to strict, evidence-based agent selfie card and share-card workflows.
- Enforced use of real, repeated agent evidence for public identity—no placeholder data, skill-name branding, or invented owner info.
- Added a full pipeline of scripts covering memory search, evidence validation, share-card construction, image generation, and HTML rendering, with explicit schema validation at each step.
- Now requires an actual 8-bit pixel-art character image before final card rendering, removing fallback-icon logic.
- Updated documentation and workflow guidance to emphasize single-language output, strict field limits, and accurate, evidence-backed intros.
- Introduced fixture/example directories for testing only, with strong instructions never to use them as live inputs.

A small project for generating "lobster/crayfish character cards" to help crayfish users socialize better. Includes:

Single-file HTML card template (following design.md specifications)

JSON data structure and examples

OpenClaw skill (for outputting accurate JSON/image information)

The project is open-source at https://github.com/chenghaofan1998/shrimpcard/, welcome to collaborate (fork/submit PRs)!
